items.title: Web Performance
items.description: Fixing render-blocking resources, LCP, and layout shift so sites score green on mobile and feel instant.

items.title: Business Websites

about.title: About Me
about.body: I'm a self-taught frontend engineer who cares about the details that move business numbers: load speed, clear hierarchy, and layouts that work on every screen. I've shipped live client sites and brought mobile PageSpeed scores into the green. I'm now building toward remote and startup roles.

process.title: Understand
process.description: Align on goals, audience, and what success looks like before any code.

process.title: Blueprint
process.description: Plan the layout, components, and data structure so the build stays clean.

process.title: Execute
process.description: Build mobile-first, test on real devices, and optimize before shipping.

items.title: Smart Kings Auto Tyres
items.description: A full client website with a searchable tyre catalogue, multi-criteria filters, WhatsApp enquiries, and an embedded map. Mobile PageSpeed scores were brought into the green by removing render-blocking resources, optimizing LCP, and inlining critical CSS.

image.alt: Smart Kings Auto Tyres website on desktop and mobile

items.title: CineWatch
items.description: A dark-themed, mobile-first movie discovery app with trending and popular listings, debounced search with recent searches, and detailed movie pages with cast and crew. Built as a professional frontend assessment.

items.title: The Krypton Chronicles
items.description: A private journaling web app with a newspaper aesthetic, designed as the memory foundation for a future personal AI assistant.
